[Figure 1]

In the figure shown, line $p$ is parallel to line $q$. What is the value of $y$?
explanation: Choice D is correct. When two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, the sum of consecutive interior angles (same-side interior angles) is $180$ degrees. Since line $p$ is parallel to line $q$, it follows that $y + 38 = 180$. Subtracting $38$ from both sides yields $y = 142$. Therefore, the value of $y$ is $142$.
